description: This file contains Polymer framework's core JavaScript code embedded within an HTML script tag, defining Polymer's base classes, features, and registration mechanisms.

classes.name: Polymer
classes.description: Main namespace object for Polymer framework, including settings, class factory, and telemetry.

classes.name: Polymer.Base
classes.description: Base class providing core features for Polymer elements, including lifecycle callbacks, property management, and behavior handling.

classes.name: Polymer.RenderStatus
classes.description: Manages rendering state and callbacks for Polymer's rendering lifecycle.

classes.name: Polymer.ImportStatus
classes.description: Alias for RenderStatus, indicating import loading status.

classes.name: Polymer.Class
classes.description: Alias for the desugar function used in class creation.

classes.name: Polymer.CaseMap
classes.description: Utility for converting between camelCase and dash-case.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Determines Polymer's configuration based on URL parameters and environment.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be called when rendering is ready.

methods.name: whenReady
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when Polymer is ready.

methods.name: addFeature
methods.description: Adds features or behaviors to Polymer classes.

methods.name: createdCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle callback invoked when an element is created.

methods.name: attachedCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle callback invoked when an element is attached to the DOM.

methods.name: detachedCallback
methods.description: Lifecycle callback invoked when an element is detached from the DOM.

methods.name: attributeChangedCallback
methods.description: Called when an observed attribute changes.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends a prototype with properties from another object.

methods.name: mixin
methods.description: Mixes properties from source into target object.

methods.name: serializeValueToAttribute
methods.description: Serializes a property value to an element attribute.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts attribute string values back to property types.
